title: helpers-of
summary: Lists record/class helper edges targeting a given type, anywhere in the index
intro: Read this to see every record or class helper that extends a type anywhere in the indexed code. helpers-of T --db lists the helper edges targeting T; it is read-only and adds --json for machine output.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint helpers-of <T> [--json] --db <db> - list record/class helper edges targeting type T anywhere in the index
